en: Black‑and‑white vertical postcard-style photograph showing the corner of an elegant multi‑storey historic building, likely from the 19th century. The façade has large arched windows with decorative leaded glass, rectangular upper windows with pediments, and quoins at the building's edge. A trellis system with climbing plants covers much of the lower façade, and a small formal garden bed with young trees stands in the foreground along a gravel path. In a side bay with a balustraded balcony, two people can be seen looking out of an open window. The surroundings suggest a park or landscaped grounds. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.
